questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ④는 '제한된 : 무제한의'의 반의어 관계 ≠ '인기 있는 : 인기 있는'의 유의어 관계이다. ①동사-명사 관계, ②형용사-명사 관계, ③반의어 관계, ⑤형용사-부사 관계로 적절하다.

options: He doesn't ___________ such a simple lie.
I ___________ my best friend when I'm in trouble.
Bad news tends to ___________ much faster than good news.
If you don't hurry up, you will ___________ the chance to see your favorite singer.
questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 단어 및 표현이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
<보기> rely on, influence, spread, miss, end
questions.explanation: ②는 '그는 그런 단순한 거짓말에 속지 않는다'는 뜻으로 fall for 또는 believe 같은 표현이 들어가야 하며, <보기>의 end(마치다)는 들어갈 곳이 없다.

questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 영영풀이가 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
<보기>
ⓐ shopper: someone who sells something
ⓑ effect: a change that is caused by an event, action etc.
ⓒ souvenir: a piece of paper with information about your payment
ⓓ product: a thing that someone grows, produces, or creates to sell
ⓔ budget: the amount of money you have to pay for something
questions.explanation: ⓐ shopper는 '구매자'인데 정의가 '파는 사람'(seller)이므로 오답. ⓒ souvenir는 '기념품'인데 정의가 '영수증'(receipt)이므로 오답. ⓔ budget은 '예산'인데 정의가 '지불해야 할 금액'(price)이므로 오답. ⓑ, ⓓ는 정확하다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ Look at the woman and her dog which are playing happily in the yard.
ⓑ You may feel sick if you eat too much fast food.
ⓒ He made a robot dog which can rescue people.
ⓓ If you will not listen to me, you will regret it.
ⓔ We saw something that glow in the dark.
ⓕ I don't know if it will snow tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 어법상 어색한 것은 3개이다. ⓐ which → that (선행사가 '사람+동물'일 때는 that 사용). ⓓ will not → do not (조건절에서 미래는 현재시제 사용). ⓔ glow → glows (주격 관계대명사 that의 동사는 선행사에 수일치).

questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 같은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
ⓐ The library has many storybooks that have pretty pictures.
ⓑ Do you know that girl who is standing by the door?
ⓒ The boy that is wearing a yellow jacket is my nephew.
ⓓ The weather of Jeju is warmer than that of Seoul.
ⓔ She said that she was busy with her homework.
ⓕ I believe that he will pass the English exam.
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 주격 관계대명사(불완전한 절을 수식), ⓒ도 주격 관계대명사이다. 따라서 ⓐ, ⓒ의 쓰임이 같다. ⓑ는 지시형용사, ⓓ는 지시대명사, ⓔⓕ는 명사절 접속사이다.

options: Do you have any fruit candies?
Can I get a refund on this candy box?

I want to know the recipe for these cookies.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 모두 고르면?
W: Oh, we have many different kinds. Here, try one of these.
B: It's sweet and delicious. How much are they?
W: We're having a sale, so this box is 8,000 won.
B: OK, I'll take it.
questions.explanation: W가 다양한 종류가 많다고 하면서 하나 드셔 보시라고 권하고 있으므로 빈칸에는 어떤 먹거리를 찾고 있는 표현이 들어가야 한다. ②'과일 사탕이 있나요?'와 ④'한국 전통 과자를 찾고 있어요.'가 적절하다.

questions.question:
위 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것의 개수는?
M: Hi, can I help you?
G: Yes. I'm looking for a traditional Korean souvenir. It's for my dad.
M: How about this fan? It is really popular.
G: Hmm ... _____________________________________?
M: How about this hat, then? This is a gat, a traditional Korean hat for men.
G: Oh, it's unique. I love it. How much is it?
M: It's 30,000 won.
G: That's a little expensive.
M: We can give you a discount if you buy two. It'll be 25,000 won each.
G: That's perfect! I'll get two hats, then.

ⓐ can I bring this back if he doesn't like it
ⓑ can you show me something else
ⓒ is there anything more unique
ⓓ would you show me another
ⓔ do you have anything else
ⓕ how much is this fan
ⓖ can I try this hat on
questions.explanation: 부채를 보여 준 남자가 소녀의 말에 다른 기념품인 갓을 보여주고 있으므로, 빈칸에는 다른 상품을 요청하는 표현이 들어가야 한다. ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ, ⓔ 총 4개의 표현이 적절하다.

questions.question:
위 대화를 다음과 같이 요약할 때, 밑줄 친 ㉠~㉤ 중, 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?
The girl ㉠wants to buy a traditional Korean souvenir for her dad. ㉡She likes a gat better than Hahoe mask. But ㉢she thinks it is a little expensive. ㉣The man offers a discount if she buys two hats, and ㉤she decides to buy two for 40,000 won in total.
questions.explanation: ㉡에서 하회탈(Hahoe mask)은 대화에 언급되지 않았다. ㉤에서 1개에 30,000원이고 할인 후 각각 25,000원씩이므로 총 50,000원이어야 하는데, 40,000원은 오답이다.

options: ⓑ: various marketing strategies를 선행사로 하는 주격 관계대명사로, that으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
ⓒ: '~에게 …을 만들어주다'라는 뜻의 'make+간접목적어+직접목적어' 구문의 직접목적어 자리에 쓰인 명사구이다.
ⓓ: '만약 ~라면'이라는 뜻의 조건을 나타내는 접속사로, 뒤에 완전한 절이 이어진다.

Do you think you are a smart shopper? Well, you may think ⓐyou are, but hold on! There are various marketing strategies ⓑwhich influence your decisions. Learning about them will make you ⓒa smarter shopper. Hunger Marketing

questions.explanation: ⓒ는 'make+직접목적어+목적격보어' 구문의 목적격보어 자리에 쓰인 명사구이다. 간접목적어가 아니라 직접목적어 앞에 오는 것이므로 설명이 부정확하다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
Yuna: That's the ⓐhotest dress on social media now. Lots of people are wearing it. I have ⓑto getting that dress, too!
Wait, Yuna! You only want the dress because you saw it again and again on social media. It isn't just you. There are a lot of people who ⓒfalling for a viral marketing strategy. Why?
Information about a product can spread quickly and widely on the Internet, just like a "virus." If a product becomes hot on social media, people naturally want to have ⓓthem. Yuna, just remember ⓔwhat a popular product isn't always right for you.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어색한 부분을 바르게 고치지 못한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'There are a lot of people'이 완전한 절을 이루므로 who 이하는 관계사절이고, falling을 falling → fall로 고쳐야 한다는 것은 틀렸다. 정확히는 'There are a lot of people who are falling for...' 형태이거나 'falling → falls'가 아니라 '복수동사로 fall'이어야 한다.

options: advertising products through TV or newspapers
making people see a product many times online
making only one product that respects a specific personal taste
spreading information about a product through computer viruses
giving consumers points for good reviews of a product

Salesperson: How about this?
Somi: Expensive! I thought ⓑwhich I could buy a lipstick for 30 dollars.
Salesperson: This is also popular.

Junho: What? The sale ends in two hours? If I don't buy the sneakers now, I will have to buy them at a higher price.
Stop, Junho! You're buying the sneakers just because you don't want to miss the sale. You're falling for a hunger marketing strategy.
If people can buy a product only for a limited time, they often feel "hungry" for it and want to buy it. About missing the sale, don't worry, Junho. You'll soon see a similar sale again.
Viral Marketing
Yuna: That's the hottest dress on social media now. Lots of people are wearing it. I have to get that dress, too!
Wait, Yuna! You only want the dress because you saw it again and again on social media. It isn't just you. There are a lot of people who fall for a viral marketing strategy. Why?
Information about a product can spread quickly and widely on the Internet, just like a "virus." If a product becomes hot on social media, people naturally want to have it. Yuna, just remember that a popular product isn't always right for you.
Anchoring Effect
Somi: I'm looking for a lipstick for my mom.
Salesperson: How about this?
Somi: Expensive! I thought I could buy a lipstick for 30 dollars.
Salesperson: This is also popular.
Somi: That's better!
Hold on, Somi! Your budget is 30 dollars, but you are buying a 40-dollar lipstick. The 40-dollar lipstick sounds cheap only because the salesperson showed you a 50-dollar lipstick first. This is an example of the anchoring effect.
Usually, the first piece of information becomes an "anchor" and influences the shopper's decision. In your case, the 50-dollar lipstick was the anchor. Somi, don't just rely on the first piece of information that is given to you.

<보기>
Jimin: If we don't want to buy a product at a higher price, we should buy it right away when there is a time sale.
Minho: I saw an advertisement for a phone case that was on sale for just one day, and I suddenly bought it. I think I was tricked by a hunger marketing strategy.
Sehwa: I spend a lot of time on social media to find the most popular items. I think the trendiest products suit everyone well.
Yuri: The clerk first showed me a 10,000-won key ring, and I bought a 7,000-won one. It was over my budget, but I was a smart shopper because I bought a cheaper one than the first one.
Mira: I heard salespeople often show us the most expensive products first. We shouldn't use them as an anchor for our purchases.
questions.explanation: 민호는 헝거 마케팅 전략에 속았다고 올바르게 이해했다. 미라는 판매자가 가장 비싼 제품을 먼저 보여주는데 그것을 닻으로 삼으면 안 된다고 올바르게 이해했다. 따라서 민호와 미라가 바르게 이해한 사람이다.

questions.answer: who are wearing uniforms, which are eating leaves, which is walking, has
questions.question:
다음 그림을 보고 <조건>에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 넣어 문장을 완성하시오.
[그림: 아이들이 동물원에서 동물들을 보고 있는 장면]
(1) The children _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ are looking at animals.
(2) There are two giraffes _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ from the tree.
(3) The elephant _____________ _____________ _____________ slowly _____________ a long nose.
<조건>
• 적절한 주격 관계대명사를 각각 사용할 것 (that은 제외할 것)
• 각각 현재진행형 시제를 사용할 것
• leaves, wear, walk, uniforms, eat, have를 한 번씩 사용할 것 (필요시 변형할 것)
questions.explanation: (1) 아이들(사람)을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 who, 현재진행형 are wearing uniforms (교복을 입고 있는). (2) 기린들(동물/사물)을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 which, 현재진행형 are eating leaves (나뭇잎을 먹고 있는). (3) 코끼리(동물/사물)를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 which, 현재진행형 is walking (천천히 걷고 있는), have를 has로 변형하여 is walking, has a long nose.

questions.answer: If Kevin goes straight one block and turns right, will start washing the dishes if, presses the blue button
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 접속사 if를 사용하여 아래 빈칸을 완성하시오. (각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것)
(1) Kevin: Where is the ABC bakery?
Jiho: Go straight one block and turn right. You'll find it on the left.
→ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________, he will find the ABC bakery on the left.
(2) Mina: What is the blue button for?
Seho: Press it. The robot will start washing the dishes.
→ The robot _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ Mina _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________.
questions.explanation: (1) 조건의 부사절은 'if Kevin goes straight one block and turns right(Kevin이 한 블록 직진해서 오른쪽으로 돈다면)'이 되며, 조건절에서는 미래를 현재시제로 나타낸다. (2) 주절은 'The robot will start washing the dishes'이고, 명사절 접속사 if가 이끄는 절은 'if Mina presses the blue button(미나가 파란 버튼을 누르면)'이 되어 'The robot will start washing the dishes if Mina presses the blue button.'이 완성된다.
